summary: ANI Pharmaceuticals filed an 8-K on November 5, 2026, disclosing a 364-day senior bridge facility of up to $676 million with JPMorgan Chase as administrative agent, entered November 4, 2026, to fund its recommended public cash offer for all outstanding shares, the 2023:1 convertible loan and 2023/2033:1 warrants of Sweden's Egetis Therapeutics AB (a Swedish public cash tender offer, the US-equivalent of a tender offer/acquisition). The facility is initially unsecured, becoming guaranteed and secured by substantially all assets upon funding, priced at ABR+1.75% or SOFR+2.75%. Watch funding conditions and Egetis acceptance levels.
